groups.sentence: Everyone stays vigilant against phishing schemes that exploit passwords, emails and other sensitive information, including when interacting with AI tools.
Everyone uses safe computing practices, such as caution with links and good antivirus protection, when working with AI.
Everyone reports suspicious messages and communications to the designated IT or security office.
Generative AI makes it easier for malicious actors to create sophisticated phishing emails, scams, deepfakes and other cybersecurity threats.
Everyone stays vigilant against AI-enabled phishing attacks and scams, and is aware of how generative AI can be exploited.
Everyone is cautious of deceptive or fake AI-generated images, videos and audio, and when creating or altering them.
